title: Equil pump support?
body:
Will there be support for the Equil pump?
http://www.microtechmd.com/en/Products/EQUIL-Patch-Insulin-Pump
TL;DR It's tubeless insulin pump like Dash Omnipod, but it's costs significantly less (~90 USD/m).
